correctness.rationale: Rule 18 local rule is (Phi x)_i=1 exactly on 001 and 100, equivalently (1+x_i)(x_{i−1}+x_{i+1}) over F2. Cyclic summation over any n-periodic input cancels both linear neighbor sums and both quadratic neighbor products, forcing even output weight. If an n-periodic image y contains 11, the unique forced input four-block is 1001 at each occurrence, permitting a cut-and-periodic-splice to construct n-periodic antecedent. If y is cyclic 11-free, the bilateral phase p_{i+1}=p_i xor y_i and x_i=p_i(1−y_i) directly produce Phi x=y, periodic with period n for even weight and 2n for odd. Thus the exact exception set is cyclic 11-free odd-weight words; a primitive output exception forces least antecedent period 2n. The transfer matrix M(t)=[[1,t],[1,0]] counts cyclic 11-free output words by weight, giving E_n=(Lucas_n−2cos(nπ/3))/2, its rational generating function z²(2−z)/((1−z−z²)(1−z+z²)), and asymptotic ~phi^n/2. Independent brute-force finite-ring input images for n=1..8 compared n vs 2n outputs and odd cyclic 11-free exceptions. The proof is bilateral and covers n=1,2 boundary; these finite cases are not an infinite proof.
